mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and sodium depletion which can potentiate orthostatic hypotension and enhance the hypotensive effects of levodopa, while thiazide diuretics may reduce levodopa efficacy through competitive renal tubular secretion.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, maintain adequate potassium and sodium levels, and assess for reduced antiparkinsonian effect; consider alternative antihypertensive if orthostatic hypotension develops.
